integrity_notes: Analytic conditional-Poisson and strict-curvature proof. Supporting symbolic and high-precision computations are reproducible. No claim of external independent mathematical review or complete historical priority.
scientific_limitations: Known homogeneous Poisson intensity, one exact deterministic count, unbounded first event time and mean-square error. No multi-query, noisy, adaptive, finite-horizon or unknown-rate design result. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: The unique optimal single count for reconstructing a Poisson first arrival
